facts_for_researcher_to_verify.mining_smelter: Vale Indonesia + PT Bahodopi Nickel Smelting Indonesia (BNSI) green smelter LNG-based di Morowali, ~Rp37,5 triliun, kapasitas ~73.000 ton/tahun (tempo.co). Indonesia ~65-67% produksi nikel dunia (2023). ~70% energi smelter dari PLTU captive batu bara; ~7,7 GW kapasitas PLTU captive (nikel.co.id/AEER). Verify current figures + LNG-vs-coal captive energy claims.
facts_for_researcher_to_verify.lng_vs_lpg: Efisiensi termal LNG ~50,86% vs LPG ~50,11% (jurnal Uniska/PNJ — verify). LPG = propana/butana dari kilang; LNG = metana didinginkan ~-162/-163C, ~1/600. LPG densitas energi per volume lebih tinggi. LNG pembakaran lebih bersih. Verify a real price/unit-panas comparison from an Indonesian source; do NOT invent MMBTU numbers.
facts_for_researcher_to_verify.contract: Take-or-pay (umumnya ~90% ToP), ACQ/DCQ/AACQ, make-up rights 2-5 thn, indeksasi JKM/TTF (spot Asia) vs ICP/Brent; di Indonesia acuan ICP umum. Konteks HGBT (harga gas bumi tertentu) untuk industri. Verify current Indonesian LNG/gas contract norms + regulated-price context (ESDM/SKK Migas).
facts_for_researcher_to_verify.regasification: Vaporizer types: Open Rack Vaporizer (ORV, air laut, suhu >5C), Submerged Combustion Vaporizer (SCV, flue gas), Ambient Air Vaporizer (AAV, udara sekitar), water bath. On-site: satuan regasifikasi (SRU) + PRS + metering. Verify vaporizer selection criteria + typical on-site capacities; avoid inventing specific SRU specs.
facts_for_researcher_to_verify.bog_troubleshooting: BOG dari heat leakage → tekanan tangki naik → venting bila lewat MARVS. Manajemen: konsumsi, reliquefaction, venting. Vaporizer icing/frost pada AAV; rollover tangki. Verify from a technical/academic source; frame at operational (not upstream/FSRU-engineering) level.
facts_for_researcher_to_verify.gagas_lng_role_CRITICAL: Company profile lists ONLY 'LNG Hub' as Gagas infrastructure. Landing page claims 'pionir dan pemimpin pasar' (FORBIDDEN). Researcher MUST verify Gagas's exact LNG role (operator LNG Hub / distributor hilir beyond-pipeline via ISO tank) and NEVER frame Gagas as produsen/likuifaksi/FSRU operator or a full 'perusahaan LNG'. Partners referenced in prior articles: PT PGN LNG, Nusantara Regas (midstream/regas).
